1023.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips with a straight back. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper legs.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips and lower the band towards the ground.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the band.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在大腿上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲，铰接臀部并将弹力带降低到地面。
当你降低弹力带时，感受腿筋的拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1087.description: A hip hinge with a strap held between your legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

1151.description: From a side-facing plank position with the straps, you twist to hit the obliques.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

1215.description: A lateral lunge with dumbbells that trains the glutes, quads and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

1279.description: A single-arm fly on an incline bench that targets the upper chest. Working one side at a time helps you spot and fix left-right differences.
instructions: Adjust the incline bench to a 30-45 degree angle.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Lie back on the bench, keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the dumbbell with your arm extended straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pause when your arm is parallel to the ground, then reverse the motion to bring the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 将倾斜凳调整至 30-45 度角。
坐在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
向后躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1343.description: Lie face down with your toes on a stability ball and lift your legs. It works the lower back and glutes with a gentle range.
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended and your toes resting on top of the stability ball.
Place your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart, and engage your core muscles.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly lift them off the ground, using your lower back and glutes to raise them as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在垫子上，双腿伸展，脚趾放在稳定球上。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，锻炼核心肌肉。
保持双腿伸直，慢慢将它们抬离地面，用下背部和臀部将它们尽可能抬高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1407.description: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it and push your heel down on the back leg. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
一只脚向后退一步，脚跟保持在地面上，腿伸直。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，感觉小腿有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

1471.description: You walk your hands out from standing into a plank and walk them back. It warms up the hamstrings, shoulders and core in one go.
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Pause for a moment, then walk your hands back towards your feet, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Once your hands reach your feet, stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
暂停片刻，然后将双手移回双脚，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
一旦你的手到达你的脚，站回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1535.description: A deadlift with a wide snatch grip. It strengthens the pulling position used in the snatch.
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip.
Set your back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close.
Stand tall with your hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar with control along the same path.

1599.description: Standing with a strap around your foot, you pull your toes toward you to stretch the hamstring and calf.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the strap with both hands and place it around the ball of your foot.
Keep your leg straight and slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your hamstring and calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat with the other leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手握住带子并将其放在脚掌周围。
保持腿伸直，从臀部慢慢向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
感受腿筋和小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
放松拉伸并用另一条腿重复。
重复所需的重复次数。

1663.description: A one-arm hammer curl over a preacher bench. It builds the brachialis and biceps without swinging.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your upper arm resting on the pad.
Hold the dumbbell with a neutral grip (palms facing your body).
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，上臂放在垫子上。
以中立握法握住哑铃（手掌朝向身体）。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1727.description: A standing one-arm overhead triceps extension with a reverse grip. It trains the triceps, long head included.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with an underhand grip and extend your arm overhead, keeping your elbow close to your head.
Keep your upper arm stationary and slowly lower the cable handle behind your head by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 背对缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近头部。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将电缆手柄降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1791.description: Tilting your head to the side while anchoring the opposite shoulder stretches the upper traps and the side of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1855.description: Lying leg raise finished with a hip lift while the head stays raised, working the whole abdominal wall.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.

1919.description: A seated hip stretch with one leg folded in front and the other tucked behind you.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1983.description: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2111.description: Combines a gentle lift of the chest with a twist to stretch the stomach muscles and the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.

2303.description: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

2367.description: A reverse lunge from a raised step that works the legs and glutes with a deeper range.
instructions: Stand on a low step with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2431.description: A wide squat with feet on benches that extends the range of motion for the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Place a bench under each foot with a wide stance.
Hold a dumbbell in front of you with both hands.
Sit your hips down between the benches.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hips.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.

2751.description: A sumo squat from a raised step box, adding range of motion for deeper work on the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand on a step box in a wide stance with toes out.
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell in front of you.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Lower as far as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.

2815.description: A V up where you pass a stability ball between hands and feet. Works the abs and builds control.
instructions: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

2879.description: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.
instructions: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

2943.description: A spider crawl performed with a band around your legs. The band adds hip effort to a classic core and shoulder crawl.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.

3007.description: A leg extension with a resistance band around your ankle. Builds the quads.
instructions: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 将阻力带固定在坚固的锚点上，并将其固定在脚踝上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
保持核心参与并保持上半身稳定，将腿伸直到身前。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3199.description: A simple skipping step with a hop on each foot. A playful way to warm up and lift your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

3263.description: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

3327.description: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, lean your body forward and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your hands.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体高度时，身体向前倾斜，双脚离开地面，用双手保持平衡。
继续降低身体，直到胸部略高于地面。
用手推动并伸展双臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
在整个运动过程中，从头部到脚后跟保持一条直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

3391.description: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

3583.description: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

3711.description: Step up onto a box or bench with one leg to build single-leg strength.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3775.description: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

3903.description: A standing glute kickback with a band while leaning forward, isolating one hip at a time.
instructions: Loop a resistance band around your ankle and anchor the other end low in front of you.
Hold a support and lean forward slightly.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Kick your leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

3967.description: Swing dumbbells in a wide arc over your head while lying on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue down to your hips.
Reverse the arc to return.

4031.description: Standing leg raise to the side against a band. It targets the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle farthest from the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side without leaning.
Pause, then lower slowly against the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

4095.description: A crunch paired with a leg raise to train both the upper and lower abdominals.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended.
Crunch your shoulders off the floor.
At the same time lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

4159.description: A push up followed by a quick kick of one leg through underneath your body. It builds chest strength with coordination.
instructions: Start in a push up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest and press back up.
Lift one hand and rotate, sweeping the opposite leg through underneath you.
Return the leg and hand to the starting position.
Repeat the push up and kick on the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your core braced.

4223.description: Rolling the outer side of your lower leg with a handheld roller. It eases tension in the muscles along the outside of the calf.
instructions: Sit with your leg bent or extended and the outer shin facing up.
Hold the roller by the handles on the outside of your lower leg.
Roll from the ankle to just below the knee.
Use gentle pressure and avoid the bone.
Pause on any tight areas.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

4287.description: Lifting your knee toward your chest to warm up the hips and activate the hip flexors. A simple dynamic drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward your chest.
Hold it for a moment.
Lower the foot with control.
Alternate legs.
Keep your standing leg steady and your back straight.

4351.description: A skull crusher on an incline bench with cable resistance, giving steady tension on the triceps.
instructions: Set an incline bench facing away from a low cable and hold the bar overhead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

4415.description: A chin-up with a band adding resistance, building the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach a band to the bar and loop it around your body or waist.
Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.

4479.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front abdomen (rectus abdominis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front abdomen (rectus abdominis) while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4543.description: A powerful hip-driven pull that brings a kettlebell from the floor to the rack position on one shoulder.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grab the handle.
Hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the bell so it lands softly in the rack at your shoulder.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Lower the bell back down with control and switch arms.

4607.description: Swinging a pipe from the front of your thighs to behind your back to open the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.

4671.description: A moving stretch for the back and sides that warms up the spine and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and arms overhead.
Reach up and over to one side.
Return to center and reach to the other side.
Let your torso rotate slightly as you go.
Move smoothly for the reps.

4735.description: A decline sit-up with a dumbbell held on your chest to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lie back until your torso is just above the bench.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on your head.
Lower slowly to the start.

4799.description: A rollout using suspension handles, a second variation. It challenges the abs as you extend your body forward and pull back.
instructions: Kneel facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll your arms forward as your body leans out in a straight line.
Go only as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

4863.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg.
Lower it slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

4991.description: A side plank with an arm rotation under the body. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

5055.description: Hanging from a bar to stretch the lats and shoulders. It also decompresses the spine.
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and feet off the floor.
Relax your shoulders and let your body lengthen.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

5119.description: Lift dumbbells from the floor by hinging at the hips. It strengthens your glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

5311.description: Slide your forearms up a wall on a stability ball to wake up the serratus anterior and improve shoulder control.
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and rest your forearms on it.
Step back slightly so your body leans in.
Slide your forearms up the ball as you reach overhead.
Push into the ball and spread your shoulder blades at the top.
Slide back down slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.

5375.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the triceps. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the back of your upper arm.
Place the roller under the triceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the armpit.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5631.description: Lateral raise with elbows bent to isolate the side delts.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

5695.description: A forward-leaning stretch that opens the hips and the back of the legs.
instructions: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

5823.description: Lunge forward step by step with a barbell on your back. It builds the legs and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through your front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Continue alternating legs for the set distance.

5887.description: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.
instructions: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Lower and switch legs.

6143.description: A seated front raise done one arm at a time. It targets the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid leaning back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6207.description: A side plank with a leg raise on the left side. It works the obliques and outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg slowly.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Repeat for your set.
Switch sides for the right-side version.

6271.description: A larsen press with a close grip: you bench with your feet off the floor, which removes leg drive and puts the work on chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with a close, shoulder-width grip.
Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.

6335.description: A floor move where you sweep one leg under your body from a side-facing support, working your obliques, shoulders and coordination.
instructions: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.

7231.description: A chest-supported raise on an incline bench to a Y position with one arm. It builds the lower traps and rear delts.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.

7551.description: Split squat with the front heel raised, loading the quads more directly.
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

7743.description: A face pull from a half-kneeling stance. The stable position keeps the focus on your rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

7999.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a band added for extra glute load. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.

8191.description: A standing leg raise to the front against cable resistance. It trains the hip flexors and front thigh.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.

8703.description: A rope pull that brings the rope toward you, working the back, arms and grip with a conditioning effect.
instructions: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

8895.description: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.
instructions: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.

10047.description: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10367.description: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.
instructions: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.

10559.description: Raise a dumbbell in front of you all the way overhead and catch it with control. It trains the front shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.

10751.description: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.
instructions: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

10879.description: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

11263.description: A one-arm cable row that adds a torso rotation. It trains the back and the twisting muscles of the core.
instructions: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

11647.description: Small, springy hops on one leg that build calf and ankle stiffness, elasticity and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

11903.description: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

0063.description: A back squat with a narrower stance, shifting more work to the quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
收紧核心并保持挺胸，同时弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0127.description: A squat with the bar held in the crook of the elbows. Works the quads, glutes and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell in the crooks of your elbows, with your hands gripping the bar for stability.
Engage your core and keep your chest lifted as you lower your hips back and down into a squat position.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
将杠铃放在肘部的弯曲处，双手握住杠铃以保持稳定。
当你将臀部向后降低到蹲姿时，启动你的核心并保持胸部抬起。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
在深蹲底部暂停片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0191.description: A one-arm cable raise done bent over, moving the arm out to the side. It works the upper back and rear shoulder with a controlled sweep.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing a cable machine.
Grasp the handle with one hand and step back to create tension on the cable.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arm out to the side, parallel to the ground, with a slight bend in your elbow.
Slowly bring your arm back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向缆绳机。
用一只手抓住手柄并向后退一步以在电缆上产生张力。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手臂向侧面伸展，与地面平行，肘部稍微弯曲。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0255.description: A shoulder drill rolling a ball in circles against a wall. It warms up the shoulder and builds control.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place a ball against it at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your arm straight but relaxed.
Roll the ball in small circles on the wall.
Do several circles in one direction.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulder down, then switch arms.

0319.description: A dumbbell fly on an incline bench. The arms open in an arc to work the upper chest.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Lie back on the bench and press the dumbbells up to the starting position, directly above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳设置为 45 度角。
坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃推至起始位置，位于胸部正上方。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0383.description: Bent forward, you open your arms wide with dumbbells. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight down in front of you, palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双臂伸直在身前，手掌相对。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0447.description: Standing, you curl an EZ bar to your shoulders. The angled grip is easier on the wrists while working the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
当你将杠铃向肩膀方向卷曲时呼气，收缩二头肌。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0575.description: Seated at a lever machine, you curl the handles up with an underhand grip. Isolates the biceps with a smooth path.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Exhale and curl the handles upward, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上，肘部靠近身体两侧。
呼气并向上弯曲手柄，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0639.description: A dip using one arm on a bench or chair behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders on one side at a time.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench or chair, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the bench or chair behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Extend your legs out in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench or chair.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 背对长凳或椅子站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手放在身后的长凳或椅子上，手指指向您的身体。
将双腿向前方伸展，脚跟保持在地面上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，使背部靠近长凳或椅子。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用另一只手臂重复。

0703.description: A side plank with the top leg raised in a star shape. It works the outer hip and obliques.
instructions: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

0767.description: A shrug with the smith bar, lifting the shoulders straight up toward the ears. It builds the upper traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
保持双臂伸直，肩膀放松。
将肩膀向耳朵方向抬起，在顶部挤压斜方肌。
保持一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0831.description: A crunch with a weight held on your chest. The added load makes the abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Curl your shoulders up off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

0959.description: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
